rca_of_the_issue: Previous RCA confirmed the crash came from VehicleDetailPage parent scope referencing reserveMet even though reserveMet only existed inside BiddingPanel. The applied fix removed the undefined prop from the parent trust-badges VehicleReserveBadge and lets the badge resolve state from the masked vehicle document. Runtime UI evidence confirms the parent page no longer crashes and both reserve badge surfaces render correctly.
